source_finding.observed_behavior: sandboxExecutionAdmitted() currently reduces admission to a static SANDBOX_COST_ADMISSION.status === ADMITTED check.
source_finding.counterevidence: Supervisor 8.63 explicitly states that remaining Sandbox quota is not assumed from Hobby plan identity and that quota/billing/upgrade/plan/charge boundaries fail closed.

hypothesis: The retained executor can preserve FREE_ONLY authority only if Sandbox.create remains downstream of both exact source/deployment identity and a directly observed or equivalently fail-closed no-charge included-entitlement admission, rather than a stale static ADMITTED constant.
counterhypothesis: Hobby plan identity alone is sufficient because provider enforcement will reject exhausted quota without monetary charge.
discriminator: Directly observe a current Sandbox quota/entitlement surface or an authoritative equivalent proving no billed/upgrade/charge path before Sandbox.create; until then supervisor 8.63 wins and execution remains blocked.
